description: This file is the main entry point for a Flutter application. It defines the root widget MyApp, which sets up the MaterialApp theme and home page, and the MyHomePage widget that displays a basic scaffold with a message indicating the app is being generated.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that sets up the MaterialApp with a theme and home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays the main scaffold with an app bar and a centered message.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: The state class for MyHomePage, building the UI with Scaffold and child widgets.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point of the application, which calls runApp with MyApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for MyApp and MyHomePage, returning widget trees.
